drought_category.dataset_vintage: US Drought Monitor (NDMC/USDA/NOAA), current-week snapshot valid through 2026-08-03 (weekly release; local gpkg mirror)
drought_category.notes: max DM class (D0=Abnormally Dry .. D4=Exceptional) of the dissolved USDM polygons containing the point (point-in-polygon; local gpkg mirror); absence = not in any drought polygon

mean_annual_dry_bulb_temperature_degc.dataset_vintage: NOAA NCEI 1991–2020 gridded climate normals (annual mean temp, CONUS)
mean_annual_dry_bulb_temperature_degc.notes: sampled from the bootstrapped CONUS COG at the point

days_above_32c_annual_count.dataset_vintage: NOAA NCEI nClimGrid-Daily derived days ≥ 32°C per year (CONUS)
days_above_32c_annual_count.notes: sampled from the bootstrapped CONUS COG at the point

in_air_quality_nonattainment.dataset_vintage: EPA Green Book NAAQS nonattainment designations (local gpkg mirror of the EPA OAQPS FeatureServer)
in_air_quality_nonattainment.notes: True if the point intersects any CURRENT-NAAQS nonattainment area (ozone/PM2.5/PM10/CO/SO2/NO2/lead combined layer); Maintenance/Attainment areas do not set it

air_quality_nonattainment_pollutants.dataset_vintage: EPA Green Book NAAQS nonattainment designations (local gpkg mirror of the EPA OAQPS FeatureServer)

housing_units_within_1km.notes: 2020 housing units across Census blocks intersecting the 1 km band; edge blocks counted whole (conservative-high)

housing_units_density_per_km2.notes: units per km2 of block land area (water excluded from the denominator); a pushback-exposure proxy, not sentiment

within_floodplain_polygon.notes: FEMA NFHL Flood Hazard Zones intersect, but not an SFHA: Zone X; AREA OF MINIMAL FLOOD HAZARD; SFHA_TF=F; FLD_AR_ID=51107C_2093; SOURCE_CIT=51107C_STUDY2.

interconnection_queue_active_capacity_co.dataset_vintage: LBNL Queued Up active interconnection-queue capacity by county
interconnection_queue_active_capacity_co.notes: sum of active-queue project capacity (MW) in county FIPS 51107

grid_price_usd_per_mwh.dataset_vintage: derived from EIA state industrial retail electricity price
grid_price_usd_per_mwh.notes: industrial retail electricity price x 1000 (USD/kWh -> USD/MWh); all-in retail (includes delivery, capital recovery, O&M) — the symmetric baseline the modeled gas cost is deliberately NOT.

surface_water_supply_use_index_huc12.dataset_vintage: USGS IWAA HUC12 surface-water supply/use index (CONUS, ≤2020-09)

public_water_system_population_served.dataset_vintage: EPA Public Water System Service Areas V3.0 (2026-03-17), CWS layer — local GeoPackage mirror, simplified + make_valid'd
public_water_system_population_served.notes: population served by CWS VA6107350 (LOUDOUN WATER - CENTRAL SYSTEM)

iso_rto.dataset_vintage: HIFLD/ORNL Independent System Operators, 2019-era delineation (archived 2025-10; SPP's 2026-04 western expansion not reflected)

egrid_co2_output_rate_kg_per_mwh.dataset_vintage: EPA eGRID2023 subregions (local gpkg mirror + Summary Tables emission rates)
egrid_co2_output_rate_kg_per_mwh.notes: eGRID2023 total-output CO2 rate for SRVC (593.419 lb/MWh × 0.45359237 kg/lb)

nearest_urban_area_distance_m.notes: 0.0 m when the point lies inside an urban area; else geodesic distance to the nearest urban-area boundary within 100 km

huc12_thermoelectric_consumptive_use_m3_.dataset_vintage: USGS Thermoelectric Water Use HUC12 consumptive use (2015)
huc12_thermoelectric_consumptive_use_m3_.notes: no thermoelectric plant in this HUC12 (valid no-data)

nearest_groundwater_well_depth_to_water_.notes: depth to water (m below land surface) at the nearest USGS groundwater well ~170 m away, latest reading 1980-08-05
